'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2025-01-03 — '''Present'''|Team Falcons}} }} Nikola "'''NiKo'''" Kovač (formerly known as '''NiKolinho''' and '''nIKOLINHO''') {{born}} is a [[:Category:Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian Serb]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player, a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player and a former semi-professional ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' player who plays for [[Team Falcons]]. He is Nemanja "[[huNter-]]" Kovač's cousin. NiKo is widely regarded as one of the greatest riflers of all time and has been in contention for the title of the best player in the world at multiple periods throughout his career. He has also been included in [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year ranking]] a record 10 times, all consecutively since 2016, peaking at #2 in 2017 and 2023. ==Gear and Settings==
